_note: Event teleport (mode 'event'): tele toi map event roi DUNG YEN cho moi tay. Moi nick tu teleport rieng (khong party/sync kenh). KEY = event key. select = payload 0x4d (hex, '0300'+id 2B LE). staging_map = map cho sau khi chon event. steps = di chuyen toi cong roi qua (giong train_routes): {'move':[x,y]} | {'gate':idx,'x','y'}. dest_map = map event dich. Them event moi = them 1 entry (capture: 0x4d chon event -> 0x0c info -> 0x06 move -> 0x14 08 gate -> 0x14 06 transit/cinematic).

exit._note: Ra khoi map event ve map thuong (out_map) roi moi teleport di mode khac duoc. Event map (12921/12922) KHONG teleport thang. Cong exit dung 0x14 04 (gate thuong).

npc_40.label: 40 NPC
npc_40._note: Event tele THANG (0x4d 03000400) vao map roi dung yen - khong cong/di bo. staging/dest=0 -> go_to_event gui select xong tra True. Thoat: go_to_town binh thuong (map cho phep teleport).

exit._note: Ra khoi map 40NPC (10991) ve map thuong (12003) - map 40NPC chan teleport. Cong exit idx 1.
